repository.description: CarPaly — Android CarPlay receiver project with Geely Xingyue L (KX11) compatibility development.

candidate.summaryZh: v1.1.55/code 43 是本地 Release 候选，基于已构建的 V1.1.54 源码基线。本轮分析 V1.1.54 车机日志后，仅将 OPUS 输出能力声明改为依赖 Android 解码器探测；音乐自动暂停与顶部状态栏问题未能由本轮日志确认根因。V1.1.55 尚未实车回归，不能据此宣称 CarPlay 功能已修复或通过。
candidate.summaryEn: v1.1.55/code 43 is a local Release candidate based on the V1.1.54 source baseline. After analyzing V1.1.54 vehicle logs, OPUS output advertisement now depends on Android decoder capability detection. This log set did not confirm root causes for reported media auto-pause or status-bar overlap. V1.1.55 has not had a vehicle regression test, so no CarPlay behavior is claimed fixed or verified.
releaseNotesZh: v1.1.55/code 43 是本地 Release 候选，不代表 GitHub Release；本地签名 APK 生成和验收结果单独记录。
源码从 V1.1.54 构建基线继续，版本台账分配 code 43；与 V1.1.54 同一签名纪元，实际车机覆盖安装仍未测试。
基于 V1.1.54 日志确认导航 OPUS 包到达但 MediaCodec 解码器创建失败、没有 PCM 帧写入；V1.1.55 在 /info 中仅于检测到平台 OPUS 解码器时公布 OPUS 输出能力。
V1.1.54 日志未复现音乐自动暂停；状态栏窗口 inset 与视频 viewport 在日志中一致，但实车可见画面未复核；这两项仍需实车测试。
HUD、仪表、油量及其他未验证车辆能力保持 NOT_TESTED。
releaseNotesEn: v1.1.55/code 43 is a local Release candidate, not a GitHub Release; local signed APK validation is recorded separately.
The source continues from the V1.1.54 build baseline and uses the same signing epoch; in-vehicle update installation remains untested.
V1.1.54 logs confirm navigation OPUS packets arrived while MediaCodec decoder creation failed and no PCM frames were written. V1.1.55 advertises OPUS output only when Android reports a decoder.
The V1.1.54 logs did not reproduce media auto-pause. Insets and the video viewport align in the logs, but the visible in-vehicle screen was not rechecked; both items need vehicle retesting.
HUD, instrument cluster, fuel data, and other unverified vehicle features remain NOT_TESTED.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈连接正常；测试 APK 版本、车型配置及有线/无线模式未记录，维护者未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported a normal connection; APK version, vehicle trim, and wired/wireless mode were not recorded and have not been independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈音乐播放约一秒后自动暂停；唤醒 Siri 时音乐可播放。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported that music pauses after about one second, while playback works when Siri is active.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈导航提示音无声；根因及修复状态尚未由本轮新实车复测确认。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported silent navigation prompts; the root cause and any fix have not been confirmed by a new vehicle retest.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈可听见 Siri 且 Siri 能听见用户；未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported hearing Siri and being heard by Siri; not independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈按键有响应；具体按键与映射未记录，未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported responsive keys; individual keys and mappings were not recorded and have not been independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈仍遮挡 CarPlay 画面。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported that the OEM status bar still overlaps the CarPlay view.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 没有可核实的实车接口调用或验收证据。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: No verifiable in-vehicle interface call or acceptance evidence is available.
